#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure: Count-Degradation Curves (exp001 + exp_fewrel_formal_80rel data)."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 13,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'xtick.labelsize': 11,
    'ytick.labelsize': 11,
    'legend.fontsize': 11,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.02,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

CB_BLUE = '#0173B2'
CB_ORANGE = '#DE8F05'

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.0, 2.8))

# (a) Few-NERD NER — exp001 Qwen3-32B-FP8 Recall
ax = axes[0]
counts_a = [1, 2, 6, 12, 22, 44, 64]
recall_a = [0.720, 0.698, 0.620, 0.539, 0.527, 0.551, 0.418]
ax.plot(counts_a, recall_a, 'o-', color=CB_BLUE, markersize=5, linewidth=1.5)
ax.set_xlabel('Schema Size (Number of Types)')
ax.set_ylabel('Recall')
ax.set_title('(a) Few-NERD NER', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xscale('log', base=2)
ax.set_xticks(counts_a)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(c) for c in counts_a])
ax.set_ylim(0.35, 0.80)

# (b) FewRel RE — exp_fewrel_formal_80rel Qwen3-32B-FP8 Accuracy
ax = axes[1]
counts_b = [1, 4, 8, 16, 32, 40, 64, 80]
acc_b = [0.8573, 0.8667, 0.8021, 0.6958, 0.6578, 0.5880, 0.5424, 0.5042]
ax.plot(counts_b, acc_b, 's-', color=CB_ORANGE, markersize=5, linewidth=1.5)
ax.set_xlabel('Schema Size (Number of Relations)')
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
ax.set_title('(b) FewRel RE', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xscale('log', base=2)
ax.set_xticks(counts_b)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(c) for c in counts_b])
ax.set_ylim(0.40, 0.95)

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=2.0)
outpath = '/root/schema-dag-extraction/figures/paper/fig_count_curves.pdf'
fig.savefig(outpath, format='pdf')
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')

# Verification
print(f'\nPanel (a) data points: {len(counts_a)}')
print(f'  counts: {counts_a}')
print(f'  recall: {recall_a}')
print(f'\nPanel (b) data points: {len(counts_b)}')
print(f'  counts: {counts_b}')
print(f'  acc:    {acc_b}')
plt.close()
PYEOF
